status: Public-source review notes; original electoral archive bytes remain pinned by the existing election manifest. Web references are not claimed to be immutable byte snapshots.

sources.supports: Original list labels and counts; each generated row additionally carries its exact pinned archive source ID and hash.
The joint AVS programme displays Europa Verde and Sinistra Italiana as constituent parties.
Italia Viva's 19 August 2022 presentation explicitly names the Azione-Italia Viva-Calenda list.
The PSI presentation names PSI, Italia Viva, Piu Europa, Libdem and Radicali. Constituents without independently needed or distinguishable support remain inside the opaque liberal/radical block.
Noi Moderati describes its 2022 federation, 2023 party formation and 2024 federation with Italia dei Valori.
SEL followed Sinistra e Liberta after the Greens and Socialists left; SEL supported Tsipras in 2014 and joined SI in 2017.
SEL/SI continuity, LeU 2018, SI plus PRC in La Sinistra 2019, and SI plus Europa Verde in AVS 2022/2024.
The contemporary election study identifies PRC, PdCI, Verdi and Sinistra Democratica in Sinistra Arcobaleno.
Possibile describes the joint Europa Verde list for the 2019 European election.
LeU is described as Articolo Uno, Possibile and Sinistra Italiana.
The candidate document names Scelta Civica, Centro Democratico and Fare in Scelta Europea.
A Green assembly report describes the 2018 joint ballot of Greens, Socialists and Area Civica.
The study explicitly places Centro Democratico with +Europa in 2018. Do not assign it to Civica Popolare.
Centro Democratico describes the joint Impegno Civico project with Luigi Di Maio.
The report reproduces the new Lega symbol and names the F of Die Freiheitlichen.
A unitary PD-Siamo Europei presentation is not proof that the later-born Azione already existed as a separate support component.
Possibile describes signing the 2022 AVS ballot agreement with Bonelli and Fratoianni.
Articolo Uno joined the PD list in 2019 while Possibile joined Europa Verde; the two LeU residual identities cannot be conflated.
The party's 2024 accounts explicitly record PRC participation in the Pace Terra Dignita joint list.
Articolo Uno joined PD-IDP for 2022 while SI joined AVS. This organizational decomposition is marked for review, not an official numerical split.
The founding press release identifies PCL and Sinistra Classe Rivoluzione, NOT PdAC, as the partners in Per una Sinistra Rivoluzionaria.
The 2018 electoral list includes PRC, PCI and a civic/organizational core. Distinguish the contemporary electoral cartel from its later organization.
Rivoluzione Civile brought together PRC, PdCI, Verdi and IdV, alongside civic participants.
The contemporary chronology identifies AP, IdV and other centrist organizations in Civica Popolare; CD instead belongs to the +Europa list.
The 2018 joint-list account includes UDC and Scelta Civica in Noi con Italia. Fare! in this cartel is not Fare per Fermare il Declino.

DSP's own transparency archive includes its 2022 election under Italia Sovrana e Popolare, supporting a provisional opaque-cartel continuity rather than a fictitious wholly new independent 2024 support component.
